'''Nalia Adollu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]]. Following the [[Ruusan campaign|Battle of Ruusan]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Adollu was chosen to be the Padawan of the [[Pyn'gani]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anno Wen-Chii]]. For at least five [[Standard year/Legends|years]], since [[995 BBY]], Adollu and her Master resided on Wen-Chii's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Polus]]. In [[990 BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] used Adollu's name and persona to sneak into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to research information for her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

==Biography==
Adollu was born around [[1010 BBY]]<ref name="RoT-One" /> in the tropical regions of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]] and was accepted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="RoT" /> After the Battle of Ruusan in 1000 BBY, Adollu was chosen as a Padawan learner by the Pyn'gani Jedi Master Anno Wen-Chii. In 995 BBY, Adollu accompanied her Master to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet Polus, Wen-Chii's homeworld, where they spent [[Time/Legends|time]] studying the native [[Species/Legends|species]] such as the [[Dral'k ice worm]], hoping to learn more about how life evolved in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In 990 BBY, while Adollu was still on Polus, her identity was used by the Sith Lord Darth Zannah, who infiltrated the Jedi Temple on Coruscant in order to find information regarding the [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[orbalisk]] organisms that plagued her Master, Darth Bane. Zannah carried out her mission successfully, as Adollu had not been seen on Coruscant for five years.<ref name="RoT" />

==Personality and traits==
An athletic, [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Human female<ref name="RoT" /> of average height,<ref name="RoT-Two" /> Adollu had long [[black]] hair. She possessed enough [[The Force/Legends|Force]] potential to be accepted as a Jedi Padawan and trained for at least five years under Master Wen-Chii.<ref name="RoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nalia Adollu was first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]]. She later received an entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
